title: ACadSharp dynamic-block merge and modeler-writer status refresh
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source issue, pull-request, documentation, and local-owner crosswalk; plan-only update
scope: Reconcile ACadSharp's dynamic-block reader/writer status after issue #1133 closure
Separate merged dynamic-block work from still-open ACIS/modeler writer proposals
Extract an optional native semantic acceptance procedure without adding per-slice work
Reconfirm stock FreeCAD ACIS and LibreCAD 3 DWG direction boundaries

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project issue, pull request, release, and documentation pages plus local plan/source-owner crosswalk

sources.revision: Issue closed by PR #1151, merged to master 2026-07-31; source pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The merged PR implements an initial DWG/DXF dynamic-parameter and evaluation-graph reader/writer path. Its description states that original dynamic blocks can be emitted intact while modified instances still lose parameter relationships. The issue follow-up names reader-retention fields needed for byte-faithful writing and offers an AutoCAD COM procedure: open, AUDIT, enumerate dynamic block properties, toggle visibility, and REGEN. A proposed write-read-write byte fixed point is same-codec stability only.

Issue #1195 and writer PR #1150/#1240 and schema refactor #1174 remain open. The proposed ACIS writer work is not part of the merged dynamic-block PR or a released writer baseline; public branch discussion includes repeated group-310 readback concerns.

sources.revision: Issue closed by merged PR #1077; pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The original report suspected missing Material/VisualStyle records, but the merged fix defaulted VPort AmbientColor to Black. It does not establish a general Material or VisualStyle writer contract.

Stock FreeCAD documentation and its closed issue state that embedded Autodesk ACIS blobs are not consumed by the standard DXF importer. LibreCAD 3 documents DWG import as optional/read-only and does not claim DWG writing. These routes cannot qualify ACIS solids or DWG writer acceptance.

assessment.planImpact: Corrects the ACadSharp dynamic-block comparator state from unavailable/unmerged to merged partial while preserving distinct edited-instance and live semantic gaps. Adds an optional, exact-profile AutoCAD behavior procedure at the existing composed gate; same-codec fixed-point is explicitly non-promoting. Confirms the ACIS writer proposals and consumer-direction limits remain separate.
